inference.body:
out_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False)
out_file.close()
out_path = out_file.name

if bit_depth == "pcm24":
    result_config = mg.pcm24(out_path)
else:
    result_config = mg.pcm16(out_path)

mg.process(
    target=target_audio,
    reference=ref_audio,
    results=[result_config]
)

return out_path
